name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
shortBenefit: Up to ₹50 Lakhs project funding with 15% to 35% non-repayable capital subsidy.
eligibilityCriteria: Any individual above 18 years of age.
At least VIII standard pass for projects costing above ₹10 Lakhs in manufacturing and ₹5 Lakhs in service sector.
New micro-enterprises only (existing units not eligible).
Special category beneficiaries (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minority/NER) get up to 35% subsidy in rural areas.
documentsRequired: Caste / Category Certificate (for special subsidy rate)
Rural Area Certificate (issued by Gram Panchayat / BDO)
applicationProcess: Submit online via KVIC e-Tracking portal or apply through designated District Industries Centre (DIC).
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (MSY)
shortBenefit: Subsidized micro-credit up to ₹1,40,000 at a deeply discounted 4% p.a. interest rate.
eligibilityCriteria: Targeted exclusively at women entrepreneurs and women SHGs.
Annual family income must be below ₹3,00,000 for urban and rural applicants.
Priority given to backward classes, artisans, and single women breadwinners.
Rebate of 0.5% for timely and prompt repayment.
documentsRequired: Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority
applicationProcess: Channelized through State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs), Regional Rural Banks, and Mahila Vikas Mandals.
department: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana
shortBenefit: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year transferred into farmer bank accounts in 3 equal tranches.
eligibilityCriteria: All landholding farmer families having cultivable land in their names.
Valid Aadhaar linked to a DBT-enabled bank account.
Institutional landholders and high income-tax payers are excluded.
applicationProcess: Self-registration available on PM-Kisan Portal or via local CSC / Village Patwari.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Health Coverage
shortBenefit: ₹5 Lakhs cashless health insurance cover per family per year across 27,000+ empaneled hospitals.
eligibilityCriteria: Families listed under SECC database or eligible state NFSA ration cards.
Universal expansion: All senior citizens aged 70+ now eligible regardless of family income.
Covers pre-existing conditions from Day 1 including secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
documentsRequired: Ration Card or Ayushman HHID Number
Age proof for Senior Citizen 70+ category
applicationProcess: Generate Ayushman Card instantly at any Empaneled Hospital or Common Service Center (CSC).

name: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit Scheme
shortBenefit: Collateral-free working capital loan starting at ₹10,000 up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy.
targetAudience: Street Vendors, Hawkers, Micro Urban Traders
eligibilityCriteria: Urban and peri-urban street vendors possessing Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation.
First tranche of ₹10,000; second tranche of ₹20,000 upon timely repayment; third tranche up to ₹50,000.
Digital transaction cashback of up to ₹100 per month.
documentsRequired: Vending Certificate or Local Urban Body (ULB) survey slip
applicationProcess: Apply on the PM SVANidhi portal or visit any Scheduled Commercial Bank or CSC center.
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Urban & Gramin)
shortBenefit: Direct financial assistance and interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakhs for pucca house construction.
eligibilityCriteria: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
Income criteria: EWS (up to ₹3 Lakhs), LIG (₹3 to ₹6 Lakhs per year).
Female head of household must be co-owner in property title.
documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Land ownership title or Patta allotment
applicationProcess: Apply online at PMAY MIS or submit physical application to Gram Panchayat / Municipal Ward.
department: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs / Rural Development

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Higher Education
shortBenefit: 100% compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursement plus monthly maintenance stipend up to ₹13,500/yr.
eligibilityCriteria: Students enrolled in post-matriculation / post-secondary recognized courses.
Annual parental/guardian income must not exceed ₹2.50 Lakhs.
Direct DBT transfer of course fee and monthly living allowance.
applicationProcess: Apply through National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or respective State Scholarship Portal.
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: National Social Assistance Senior Pension (IGNOAPS)
shortBenefit: Monthly direct social security pension with additional state top-up for elderly citizens.
targetAudience: Senior Citizens aged 60+ living below poverty line
eligibilityCriteria: Person must be 60 years or above.
Applicant must belong to a household living below the poverty line (BPL).
Increased financial allocation for super-seniors aged 80 and above.
applicationProcess: Apply via District Social Welfare Office, CSC Portal, or Umang Mobile App.

name: PM Vishwakarma Artisan & Craftsman Scheme
shortBenefit: ₹15,000 modern toolkit grant + collateral-free loans up to ₹3,00,000 at 5% interest rate.
targetAudience: Traditional Artisans (Carpenters, Blacksmiths, Potters, Weavers, etc.)
eligibilityCriteria: Traditional artisans engaged in any of the 18 recognized family-based trades.
Includes 5-7 days basic skill training with ₹500/day stipend.
First loan tranche ₹1 Lakh, second loan tranche ₹2 Lakhs with zero collateral.
documentsRequired: Proof of trade activity / Gram Panchayat verification
applicationProcess: Register at nearest CSC center on PM Vishwakarma portal with biometric verification.
department: Ministry of MSME & Ministry of Skill Development
